name: kairos-desktop
description: Personal learning check-in, schedule, AI companion, and music desktop app.
author: Kairos

scripts.renderer:build: pnpm build:i18n && pnpm sync:music-native-controller && vite build --config renderer/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm verify:version && pnpm validate:i18n && pnpm typecheck && node --check scripts/kairos-dev.cjs && node --check scripts/kairos-doctor.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-release-version.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-windows-signing.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-windows-signatures.cjs && node --check electron/scripts/release/verify-pack-dir.js && node --check app/features/assistant/ai-chat.js && node --check app/features/calendar/calendar-core.cjs && node --check app/features/calendar/schedule-feature.js && node --check app/features/habits/habit-core.cjs && node --check app/features/habits/habits-feature.js && node --check app/features/reminders/reminder-core.cjs && node --check app/features/reminders/reminder-feature.js && node --check app/features/settings/settings-feature.js && node --check app/shell/navigation/stitch-shell.js && node --check app/shell/player/music-player.js && node --check electron/data/sqlite/index.js && node --check electron/data/app-state/index.js && node --check electron/scripts/audit/app-state-audit.js && node --check electron/scripts/audit/desktop-data-audit.js && node --check electron/main/index.js && node --check electron/preload/index.cjs && node --check electron/services/ai/provider-registry.js && node --check electron/services/ai/provider-settings.js && node --check electron/services/ai/providers.js && node --check electron/services/ai/langchain-agent.js && node --check electron/services/calendar/calendar-backgrounds.js && node --check electron/services/music/ai-music-controller.js && node --check electron/services/music/netease-api-service.js && node --check electron/services/web/web-search.js && node --test electron/tests/unit/**/*.test.js electron/tests/integration/**/*.test.js
scripts.verify:release: pnpm check && pnpm dist:win && pnpm release:manifest && pnpm verify:dist && pnpm verify:signatures:win
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm verify:version && pnpm prepare:ffmpeg && pnpm build:styles && pnpm build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm verify:version && pnpm check:signing:win && pnpm prepare:ffmpeg && pnpm build:styles && pnpm build:renderer && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win: pnpm verify:version && pnpm check:signing:win && pnpm prepare:ffmpeg && pnpm build:styles && pnpm build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis portable
